publish.title: Publish plugin
publish.intro: Fill in the template, zip it, then upload. The SHA-256 checksum is computed in the browser for the selected file—no manual entry.
publish.introSkill: Fill in metadata, upload a PNG icon and your skill folder (must include SKILL.md at the root). We generate plugin.yaml for you and package it as a zip for upload.
publish.templateDownloadFailed: Could not get the template download link. Try again or contact an admin.
publish.templateHint: Download the template zip; edit as needed, then zip and upload.
publish.fieldSkillNameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; must follow the skill slug rules, e.g. my-demo-skill.
publish.fieldPkgNameSwarmSkillHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must match the selected folder root, e.g. my-demo-swarmskill.
publish.fieldPkgNameAgentHelp: Field name: name. Prefilled from zip when possible; form input wins on submit (written to plugin.yaml / manifest.id). Renaming must match in-package paths and tool file references.
publish.fieldSkillMetadataLockedHint: This skill is already published. Package name and display name are fixed; you can update description and tags for this release.
publish.fieldMetadataLockedHintSwarmSkill: This Swarm Skill is already published. Package name and display name are fixed; you can update description and tags for this release.
publish.fieldMetadataLockedHintAgent: This Agent asset is already published. Package name and display name are fixed.
publish.fieldSkillDisplayNameHelp: Shown on the Hub list and detail pages.
publish.fieldSkillDescriptionHelp: If left blank, the listing summary uses the `description` field in SKILL.md frontmatter. If you type here, it is written to plugin.yaml and may differ from SKILL.md.
publish.fieldSkillDescriptionPlaceholder: Leave blank to use SKILL.md frontmatter description
publish.fieldSkillDescriptionSwarmSkillHelp: If left blank, the listing summary uses SKILL.md frontmatter description (kind must be swarm-skill).
publish.fieldDisplayNameSwarmSkillHelp: Shown on the Hub list and detail pages.
publish.fieldDisplayNameAgentHelp: Form field display_name. Prefilled from zip; form input wins on submit.
publish.fieldDescriptionAgentHelp: Form field description. Prefilled from zip; form input wins on submit.
publish.fieldTagsAgentHelp: Form field tags. Prefilled from zip; form input wins on submit.
publish.fieldSkillIconHelp: PNG only; written to icon.png at the package root.
publish.fieldSkillFolderHelp: Select a local folder (same layout as the template: SKILL.md at root; optional scripts, references, assets). Files are packed under a top folder matching the package name.
publish.fieldSkillFolderSwarmSkillHelp: Select a local folder with SKILL.md at root (frontmatter kind: swarm-skill). Files are packed under a top folder matching the package name.
publish.fieldSkillIconSwarmSkillHelp: PNG only; written to icon.png at the package root.
publish.skillPackFailed: Packaging failed. Check fields and folder layout.
publish.skillErrorInvalidName: Invalid name: use a leading lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or single hyphens between segments.
publish.skillErrorInvalidNameTooLong: Skill name must be at most 64 characters.
publish.skillErrorInvalidVersion: Version must be three numeric segments, e.g. 1.0.0 (no leading v).
publish.skillErrorInvalidTag: Empty tag found—remove extra commas or fill every tag.
publish.skillErrorInvalidAuthor: GitCode username missing. Please sign in again.
publish.skillErrorMissingRelativePath: Files lack relative paths—use a browser that supports folder upload (Chrome / Edge).
publish.skillErrorSkillMdNotAtRoot: SKILL.md must sit at the root of the selected folder (not nested).
publish.skillErrorMissingSkillMd: SKILL.md is missing at the folder root.
publish.skillErrorMissingSkillMdDescription: Description is empty and SKILL.md frontmatter has no valid description—fill one of them.
publish.skillErrorInvalidSkillMdFrontmatterYaml: SKILL.md frontmatter is not valid YAML—check syntax and indentation (for team-skill, indent each list item and nested fields under `roles:`). You can also fill the marketplace description in the form.
publish.skillErrorInvalidSkillKind: SKILL.md frontmatter kind must be empty, team-skill, or swarm-skill. Fix any other non-empty value before publishing.
publish.skillErrorIconNotPng: Icon must be a valid PNG file.
publish.skillErrorTooManyEntries: Too many files in the package.
publish.skillErrorTeamSkillRolesRequired: SKILL.md frontmatter must include a roles list when kind is team-skill.
publish.skillErrorTeamSkillRolesMin2: SKILL.md frontmatter roles must contain at least 2 entries.
publish.skillErrorTeamSkillRoleNoId: One or more entries in SKILL.md frontmatter roles is missing a valid id.
publish.checksumHint: Computed automatically after you pick a file (sent as X-Checksum-SHA256). Re-select the file if you change the zip.
publish.checksumHintSkill: After the form and folder are ready, the zip is built and hashed automatically (X-Checksum-SHA256). Any change triggers a rebuild.
publish.checksumPlaceholder: 64-char lowercase hex appears after you choose a zip
publish.hashFailed: Could not compute checksum. Try another file or browser.
publish.fieldPluginIdHelp: Choose “New plugin” for a first publish (plugin_id assigned by the server). Pick a listed plugin to publish a new version of it.
publish.fieldPluginIdHelpSkill: Choose “New skill” for a first publish. Pick a listed skill to publish a new version.
publish.fieldVersionHelp: e.g. 1.0.0; if empty, the version from the package is used.
publish.fieldVersionSkillHelp: Written to plugin.yaml; must be semver-like, e.g. 1.0.0.
publish.fieldVersionSwarmSkillHelp: Written to plugin.yaml; must be semver-like, e.g. 1.0.0.
publish.fieldVersionAgentHelp: Form field version. Prefilled from zip; form input wins on submit (semver-like, e.g. 1.0.0).
publish.visibilityHint: Private Skills stay out of the public marketplace but use the same review flow and can be granted to groups.
publish.visibilityLockedHint: New versions keep the Skill's current visibility; it cannot be changed here.
